hypotheses.claim: Semantically equivalent surface transformations preserve a measurable part of the context effect.
Relation-specific ablations produce family-specific behavioral effects.
A residual semantic-context effect remains after output-budget mediation is reduced.
The direction of selected effects replicates across more than one model/tokenizer family.
Dynamic relevance organization can outperform a compute-matched static swarm on selected tasks.
Semantic organization can improve proposal quality without widening authority when coupled to the existing governed action path.
